review_requirements: Resolve the reversed Group-A/Group-B mapping before any treatment-coded analysis.
Adjudicate the primary knowledge endpoint, questionnaire scoring and immediate-versus-one-month contrast.
Specify matching, clinic adjustment, population, estimand, mixed model, missingness and multiplicity.
Replace or justify the first-appointment binary power calculation for the actual primary endpoint.
Keep seropositivity and clinic association models exploratory unless independently prespecified.
Verify every evidence excerpt against the rendered one-based physical PDF page.
